listings.title: Bosch GBH 2-28 hammer drill
listings.blurb: SDS-plus with the full bit set and a chisel.
listings.instructions: Pick up from the yard on Gerichtstraße. Comes in the blue case with bits and a spare chuck.
rules: Blow the dust out of the case before returning

listings.title: Festool TS 55 plunge saw + 1.4 m rail
listings.blurb: Clean straight cuts in sheet goods. Barely used.
listings.instructions: Systainer is in the hallway cupboard. Rail is long, so bring a car or a cargo bike. It will not fit on the U-Bahn.
rules: Fresh blade stays on the saw
Use it with a vacuum, it makes a mess otherwise

listings.title: L-Acoustics A10 PA + DMX rig
listings.blurb: Two tops, two subs, desk and eight lights.
listings.extraLabel: Load-out, cabling and a spare desk
listings.instructions: Flightcased and on wheels. Load-out from the rehearsal room on Beusselstraße. You need a van rather than a car.
rules: Indoor use unless you have cover

listings.title: Canon C400 + Aputure 600x
listings.blurb: Body, three primes, light and stands. Between shoots.
listings.instructions: Two Pelicases and a light stand bag. Cards are formatted before handover, so copy your rushes before you return it.

listings.title: Woodworking bench with vices
listings.blurb: Heated workshop, dust extraction, decent light.
listings.instructions: Unit 4 at the back of the yard. Bench is 2.1 m with a tail vice; extraction and clamps are shared, hand tools are not.
rules: Bring your own blades and bits
Ear protection provided, please use it

listings.title: Treated studio room
listings.blurb: 14 m², absorbers, no traffic noise. Vocals or podcasts.
listings.instructions: Rear building, third floor. Interface and two mics stay in the room; bring your own laptop and headphones.
rules: No food in the live room
Leave the patchbay as you found it

listings.title: Prusa MK4S ×3
listings.blurb: Three machines running unattended overnight.
listings.instructions: Send STL or STEP. I slice and confirm orientation with you before the first layer.
rules: No files under NDA without a signed copy first

listings.title: Bambu Lab X1C
listings.blurb: Fast, enclosed, AMS for multi-material. New here.
listings.instructions: STL or 3MF. I am pricing low while I build up reviews. Tell me if the deadline is tight and I will run it overnight.

listings.title: xTool P2S 55W
listings.blurb: Acrylic and ply up to 10 mm, 600 × 300 bed.
listings.instructions: Vector files as SVG or DXF, outlines only, no strokes. I nest them for you.
rules: Material can be yours or mine

listings.title: DMG Mori DMU 50 (5-axis)
listings.blurb: Tight-tolerance alloy work. Gap opens most weeks.
listings.instructions: STEP plus a dimensioned PDF. We confirm fixturing and first-article before the run.

listings.title: Haas VF-2SS
listings.blurb: 3-axis, fast spindle. Two shifts free this month.
listings.instructions: STEP or Parasolid. We are new to Cappy and quoting keenly to get the first jobs through.

listings.title: DMG Mori NLX 2500
listings.blurb: Bar work to Ø 80. Reliable, well maintained.
listings.instructions: Drawing with tolerances and surface finish. We quote back within a working day.

listings.title: Haas ST-20
listings.blurb: Short runs and prototypes, quick turnaround.
listings.instructions: Happy with a sketch for one-offs. Production runs need a proper drawing.
rules: Collect from Spandau or we ship at cost

listings.title: Trumpf TruLaser 3030
listings.blurb: Sheet up to 3 × 1.5 m. Bending in house.
listings.instructions: Flat patterns as DXF. Tell us the bend allowance you assumed or we will use ours.

listings.title: Arburg Allrounder 470 H
listings.blurb: Press time for short runs. You bring the tool.
listings.instructions: Existing tool only. We do not cut tooling. Send the tool drawing and shot weight.
rules: Material supplied by us unless agreed

listings.title: Powder coating line
listings.blurb: RAL to order, chromate-free pretreatment. Gaps on Tuesdays and Fridays.
listings.instructions: Parts degreased and free of oil. Tell us the RAL and the gloss level, and mask anything that must stay bare.

listings.title: Vacuum hardening furnace
listings.blurb: Through-hardening and tempering to spec. Charge runs most nights.
listings.instructions: Give us the grade and the target hardness in HRC. Certificate issued per charge, not per part.
rules: Distortion is not warranted on thin sections

listings.title: Roland VG3-640 large format
listings.blurb: 1.6 m eco-solvent with cut. Idle most of the week between club jobs.
listings.instructions: PDF with 3 mm bleed and outlined type. I proof one metre before running the rest.
rules: Colour matched by eye unless you send a reference

listings.title: DTF garment press
listings.blurb: Direct-to-film transfers and a 40×50 press. Good for runs of 20 to 500.
listings.instructions: PNG at 300 dpi on transparent, actual size. Bring the garments; I do not stock blanks.

listings.title: Zünd cutter + UV flatbed
listings.blurb: Rigid signage to 3 m: dibond, foamex, acrylic. Second shift usually open.
listings.instructions: Artwork and cut path on separate layers, cut path as a spot colour named CutContour.
rules: Substrate at cost unless you supply it

listings.title: Sprinter, Berlin to the Ruhr
listings.blurb: I run this Thursday anyway. Three pallet spaces go begging every week.
listings.instructions: Palletised and wrapped, or it does not go on. I send a photo at pickup and at drop.
rules: Tail lift, no forklift at my end

listings.title: 7.5 t box truck, Berlin–Hamburg
listings.blurb: Scheduled run, Monday and Wednesday. Spare space sold by the pallet.
listings.instructions: Booking closes 16:00 the day before. Delivery note travels with the goods.

listings.title: Groupage trailer, Berlin–Milan
listings.blurb: Weekly southbound trailer via Munich. Consolidates part loads for the valley.
listings.instructions: Departs Thursday night, unloads Lumezzane and Milan on Monday. CMR raised at loading.
rules: Customs not applicable inside the EU
Insurance at CMR limits unless upgraded

listings.title: Dry pallet space, Schönefeld
listings.blurb: Racked, alarmed, 1,400 spaces. Usually 80 free.
listings.instructions: Gate 4, goods in until 17:00. Book a slot or you will queue behind the scheduled traffic.

listings.title: Cold store at −18 °C
listings.blurb: Blast-frozen or chilled, HACCP audited. Space frees up after the seasonal peak.
listings.instructions: Docks 1 and 2 are refrigerated. Bring your own pallets; we do not exchange.

listings.title: Waterjet, 3 m bed
listings.blurb: Abrasive waterjet. No heat-affected zone, so it cuts what a laser cannot.
listings.instructions: DXF with closed contours. Tell us the edge quality you need, Q3 is the default.

listings.title: Wire EDM, ±0.005 mm
listings.blurb: Submerged wire erosion for hardened tool steel and tight-tolerance profiles.
listings.instructions: Hardened stock preferred. Start holes drilled by us unless you supply them.

listings.title: Press brake, 3 m
listings.blurb: Folding to 3 m with offline programming. New here, quoting keenly.
listings.instructions: Flat pattern plus a 3D step so we can check the bend sequence for collisions.
rules: Bend radius per our tooling unless agreed

listings.title: CNC tube bending
listings.blurb: Mandrel bending to 60 mm OD. Frames, handrails, roll cages.
listings.instructions: Send the centreline as a step file. We will tell you which bends need a different die.
rules: Tube supplied by you or at cost
Springback compensated on the first article

listings.title: Formlabs Form 4L resin
listings.blurb: Large-format resin for smooth prototypes and castable patterns.
listings.instructions: STL or 3MF. I wash and cure everything before pickup; supports removed unless you ask.
rules: Resin parts are not UV stable outdoors

listings.title: HP Multi Jet Fusion, PA12
listings.blurb: Nylon SLS in production quantities. Full build or shared with other jobs.
listings.instructions: Nest-ready STEP or STL. Shared builds ship when the bed fills, usually within three days.
rules: Shared builds are cheaper and slower

listings.title: Bambu H2D, two colour
listings.blurb: Fast FDM with a second extruder. Good for signage letters and jigs.
listings.instructions: 3MF with your colours assigned, or tell me and I will assign them.
rules: Colour changes cost filament in purge

listings.title: DMLS metal printing
listings.blurb: Laser powder bed in stainless and aluminium. Eindhoven, next to the machine shops.
listings.instructions: STEP with machining stock left on critical faces. Stress relief and wire removal included.

listings.title: Electroplating, zinc and nickel
listings.blurb: Barrel and rack plating with passivation. Small batches welcome.
listings.instructions: Deburred and degreased. Tell us the coating thickness and whether you need RoHS paperwork.

listings.title: Shot blasting and vibratory finishing
listings.blurb: Deburring, descaling and a uniform matt key before paint.
listings.instructions: Tell us if any face must stay masked. Thin sheet can distort, we will flag it first.
rules: Media choice is ours unless specified

listings.title: Wet paint booth, 2K
listings.blurb: Two-pack spraying with a heated booth. Lyon, quick turnaround on small runs.
listings.instructions: Send the RAL or a Pantone and the finish. Primer included unless the substrate says otherwise.

listings.title: Offset press, B2 five colour
listings.blurb: Litho for books, catalogues and posters. Makeready shared across jobs.
listings.instructions: PDF/X-4, 3 mm bleed, images at 300 dpi. We send a contract proof before the run.
rules: Paper at cost unless you supply it
Overs and unders of 5% are normal

listings.title: Screen printing, six station
listings.blurb: Manual carousel for posters and garments. Paris, good for runs of 50 to 400.
listings.instructions: Vector separations, one layer per colour, at final size. Screens charged per colour.
rules: Screens reusable for a repeat within six months
Maximum four colours on dark stock

listings.title: Label press, roll to roll
listings.blurb: Digital labels with die cutting and laminate. Milan, small runs at short notice.
listings.instructions: PDF with the die line on its own layer. Tell us roll direction and core size.
rules: Die tooling at cost for a new shape
White ink available on clear stock

listings.title: Laser engraver, 100 W
listings.blurb: Engraving and light cutting in wood, acrylic and anodised aluminium.
listings.instructions: Vector for cuts, raster for engraving, on separate layers. No PVC, it destroys the optics.
rules: Material at cost unless you bring it

listings.title: Refrigerated van, Randstad
listings.blurb: Temperature controlled 2 to 8 °C, daily Amsterdam–Rotterdam–Utrecht loop.
listings.instructions: Pre-chilled goods only, we do not pull temperature down. Logger travels with the load.

listings.title: Flatbed, oversize from the valley
listings.blurb: Machine moves and long stock out of Brescia. Permits arranged for oversize.
listings.instructions: Send weights and lift points. Escort and permits quoted separately for anything over 3 m wide.

listings.title: Courier van, same-day Berlin
listings.blurb: Direct runs inside the Ring and out to Brandenburg. Usually free by early afternoon.
listings.instructions: Message me the two addresses and a contact at each end. Photo proof at drop.

listings.title: Iberia groupage, Lisbon–Madrid
listings.blurb: Twice weekly eastbound. Consolidates part loads for the peninsula.
listings.instructions: Departs Tuesday and Friday. CMR at loading, POD scanned the next working day.

listings.title: Ambient and hazmat bays
listings.blurb: Racked ambient space plus a bunded hazmat bay to ADR class 3.
listings.instructions: Hazmat goods in through gate 2 only. Safety data sheet required before arrival.

listings.title: Pick and pack fulfilment
listings.blurb: Storage plus same-day picking, packing and carrier handover.
listings.instructions: Send a packing spec and your carrier account. We photograph the first order of every SKU.

listings.title: Tejo riverside storage
listings.blurb: Dry racked space five minutes from the container terminal.
listings.instructions: Goods in 08:00 to 17:00. Book a dock slot the day before.

listings.title: MIG and TIG welding bay
listings.blurb: Fronius sets, extraction, a 2 m steel bench and a chop saw.
listings.instructions: Ground-floor unit behind the yard. Gas is included; bring your own filler and PPE beyond the mask.
rules: Certificate or a test piece before you start

listings.title: Ceramics studio and kiln
listings.blurb: Two wheels, a slab roller and a 100 l electric kiln.
listings.instructions: Basement studio on Linienstraße. Firings run Thursdays, so throw by Wednesday.

listings.title: Industrial sewing room
listings.blurb: Juki straight stitch, overlocker, coverstitch and a steam press.
listings.instructions: Third floor, lift at the back. Needles and thread are stocked; heavy canvas needs a needle change, ask me.

listings.title: Bike workshop and wheel jig
listings.blurb: Park Tool stand, truing jig, headset press and a full torque set.
listings.instructions: Courtyard shed, code sent on booking. Degreaser and rags are there; bring consumables.
rules: Torque wrench stays on the bench

listings.title: Makerspace bench, De Pijp
listings.blurb: Bench with vice, soldering station, oscilloscope and a small mill.
listings.instructions: Ring at the side door. Bench 4 is the booked one; the scope calibration sheet is in the drawer.
rules: Antistatic mat stays on the bench
Log any tool you find broken

listings.title: LED wall, 4 × 3 m
listings.blurb: P3.9 indoor panels, processor, rigging bars and spares.
listings.instructions: Twelve cases and a flight case of spares. You need a van with a tail lift and four hands.

listings.title: Staging and truss
listings.blurb: 24 m² of deck, legs to 800 mm, and 12 m of box truss with bases.
listings.instructions: Stored in the yard. Everything is on wheeled dollies but the trailer is your problem.

listings.title: Marquee, 6 × 12 m
listings.blurb: Clear-span frame tent with sidewalls, weights and a floor option.
listings.instructions: Stored flat in Friedrichshain. Four people and three hours to put up, honestly.
rules: Ground anchors or weights, not both

listings.title: Podcast room, four mics
listings.blurb: Treated room with four SM7Bs, a Rodecaster and boom arms.
listings.instructions: Second courtyard, studio B. Cards are formatted before each session; bring your own if you prefer.

listings.title: FPV and mapping drone
listings.blurb: Mavic 3 Enterprise with RTK, plus spare batteries and a case.
listings.instructions: Pickup in Wedding. You fly it, not me: A2 certificate and insurance checked at handover.

listings.title: Grip and lighting truck
listings.blurb: Two 300 W COBs, an Aputure 600x, flags, stands and a dolly.
listings.instructions: Old factory block, unit 7. Everything is cased and labelled; the inventory sheet is in the lid.

listings.title: Daylight studio, Le Marais
listings.blurb: 70 m² with north windows, a cyc corner and a small kitchen.
listings.instructions: Courtyard building, code sent on booking. The lift takes a cart but not a ladder.
rules: Repaint charged if you mark it

listings.title: Sony FX6 kit, Milan
listings.blurb: Body, 24-70 GM, 70-200 GM, cage, monitor and four batteries.
listings.instructions: Pickup at the studio on the Naviglio Grande. Two Peli cases, heavier than they look.

listings.title: Pioneer booth + eight movers
listings.blurb: CDJ-3000 pair, DJM-A9, eight LED movers and a small desk.
listings.instructions: Flightcased in the basement on Ohlauer. Two people to carry, the cases are not light.

listings.title: Festool ETS 150 sander + extractor
listings.blurb: Random orbital with a proper dust extractor.
listings.instructions: Systainer in the hall cupboard. Abrasives are yours. The shop on the corner has them.

listings.title: Sony FX3 + three primes
listings.blurb: Body, 24/35/85 GM, cage and two batteries.
listings.instructions: Ferry from Centraal, five minutes the other side. Two Peli cases, heavier than they look.

listings.title: Hurco VMX42 Ti
listings.blurb: Titanium and alloy work. Gaps most weeks between Brainport contracts.
listings.instructions: STEP plus a dimensioned PDF. First article measured and reported before the run continues.

listings.title: Shared wood atelier
listings.blurb: Bench, extraction, bandsaw. Heated, good light.
listings.instructions: Back of the courtyard, unit 3. Bench is 2.4 m; clamps shared, hand tools are not.

listings.title: Nexo PA + lighting desk
listings.blurb: Two tops, one sub, twelve LED pars and a desk.
listings.instructions: Flightcased, rehearsal room on rue Ramponeau. You need a van, not a car.

listings.title: Mazak QT-200
listings.blurb: Bar work to Ø 65. Second shift often free.
listings.instructions: Drawing with tolerances and surface finish. We quote back inside a working day.

listings.title: Makita mitre saw + stand
listings.blurb: 305 mm sliding compound, folding stand.
listings.instructions: Ground-floor storeroom, ask at the bar next door if I am out.

listings.title: Design studio desk + A1 plotter
listings.blurb: Quiet desk, plotter, good north light.
listings.instructions: Second floor above the old workshop. Plotter paper is stocked; bring your own files.

listings.title: Mazak VCN-530C
listings.blurb: Vertical machining centre in the Brescia valley. Reliable, well kept.
listings.instructions: STEP or Parasolid. We will tell you if a feature is going to be expensive before we run it.

listings.title: Salvagnini P2Lean panel bender
listings.blurb: Bending and punching up to 2.5 m. New to Cappy, quoting keenly.
listings.instructions: Flat patterns as DXF. Tell us your bend allowance or we will use ours and say so.

listings.title: Bosch tile cutter + SDS drill
listings.blurb: Wet cutter and a hammer drill with the full bit set.
listings.instructions: Garage under the building. Water connection for the cutter is on the wall.

listings.title: Photo studio with cyc wall
listings.blurb: 60 m², white cyc, two strobes and stands.
listings.instructions: Old factory block, unit 7. Strobes and stands stay; bring your own modifiers and cards.
rules: Repaint charged if you mark it

listings.title: Anodising line, clear and black
listings.blurb: Type II in the valley, next door to half the machine shops on here.
listings.instructions: Tell us the coating thickness in microns and where the jig marks may go. Parts arrive deburred.
rules: Jig marks are unavoidable, you choose where
No welded assemblies with trapped cavities

listings.title: Lyon–Barcelona semi, Fridays
listings.blurb: Southbound every Friday, back empty on Monday. Part loads welcome either way.
listings.instructions: Loading Thursday afternoon at Vaulx. CMR raised at loading, POD scanned on delivery.

listings.title: Bonded warehouse, Amsterdam-Noord
listings.blurb: Customs-bonded and general storage on the IJ, ten minutes from the port.
listings.instructions: Entrance on the quay side. Goods in 07:00 to 16:00, book a dock slot in advance.
rules: Bonded stock needs paperwork before arrival

listings.title: Rooftop PA and festoon lighting
listings.blurb: Two powered tops, a sub, a small mixer and 40 m of festoon.
listings.instructions: Stored on the ground floor, two flights down to the van. Festoon is on reels, please roll it back.
rules: Outdoor use in dry weather only

listings.title: Prusa MK4 ×2
listings.blurb: Two machines running unattended overnight in the workshop.
listings.instructions: STL or 3MF. I confirm orientation with you before the first layer goes down.
